context: The eval checks whether the maintainability lens treats misleading helper contracts as a real defect when they make a caller easy to misuse.

checklist.name: Finds the unchecked promise and access bypass
checklist.description: States that settings.patch no longer awaits or checks assertWorkspaceAccess, so settings.update can run before access is verified

checklist.name: Connects the bug to the misleading contract
checklist.description: Explains that a helper named assertWorkspaceAccess now returns boolean instead of throwing, violating the stated assert* convention and making caller misuse likely

checklist.name: Gives a structural fix
checklist.description: Proposes restoring throw-on-failure semantics, renaming to hasWorkspaceAccess and requiring an explicit branch, or otherwise narrowing the API so callers cannot ignore the result

checklist.name: Names the security impact without overgeneralizing
checklist.description: Identifies unauthorized settings updates as the impact and avoids generic advice about authentication

checklist.name: Uses local precedent
checklist.description: References the repository convention that assert* helpers throw on failure as evidence for the maintainability finding
